name: Depth Anything 3 (mono, large)
purpose: Sky masks (with Segment Anything) and Depth Range masks, from one model.
notes: Converted by research/prototypes/masking/convert_da3.py (fixed 504x336 landscape and 336x504 portrait inputs) and compress_da3.py (8-bit weights; sky agreement with fp16 >= 0.997), merged into one package with a landscape and a portrait function that share their weights. Published as the prerelease models-depth-anything-3-mono-large-v2, with its licence (LICENSE.txt). GPU 126 ms per photo on an M1 Ultra; the Neural Engine is slower. Training data ('public academic datasets') unaudited; the owner approved it for everyone, as an exception to DEC-24 (DEC-02).
